items.title: 2026 Karak church shooting
items.description: On 23 October 2026, three gunmen opened fire on the Greek Orthodox St George's Church during a funeral procession in the Jordanian village of Hmoud near Karak, killing nine people and wounding between 34 and 40 others, according to differing official and media counts. The attack is the deadliest on Jordan's Christian community in the country's modern history

items.title: PHP2Shell
items.description: PHP2Shell is a pair of high-impact computer vulnerabilities concerning memory safety flaws in PHP versions 5.4–8.5 that allow remote code execution (RCE) by a potential malicious user to gain remote control of the website host. The vulnerabilities were discovered with the help of AI in August 2026 and their existence was publicly announced on 20 October 2026

items.title: Turkistan Islamic Party
items.description: The Turkistan Islamic Party (TIP) is an Islamic militant organisation founded in Pakistan by Hasan Mahsum, who relocated the organization to Afghanistan following anti-terror crackdowns by the Pakistani government. Its stated goal is to establish an Islamic state in Xinjiang, China, and throughout the rest of Central Asia.
